patch:
@@ -37,17 +37,6 @@ jobs:
           tenant-id: ${{ vars.ARM_TENANT_ID }}
           subscription-id: ${{ vars.ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
 
-      - name: Fetch MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID from App Configuration
-        # This repo's tofu/oauth.tf publishes the key
-        # `workout/microsoft_oauth_client_id` — fetched here so the tofu-managed
-        # value is the source of truth for the build.
-        run: |
-          MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID=$(az appconfig kv show \
-            --name infra-appconfig \
-            --key workout/microsoft_oauth_client_id \
-            --query value -o tsv)
-          echo "MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID=${MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
-
       - name: ACR login
         run: az acr login --name romainecr
 
@@ -57,7 +46,6 @@ jobs:
           IMAGE="romainecr.azurecr.io/kill-me:${TAG}"
           docker build \
             --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER="${TAG}" \
-            --build-arg VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID="${MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID}" \
             -t "$IMAGE" .
           docker push "$IMAGE"
           echo "TAG=${TAG}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

@@ -10,13 +10,10 @@ RUN npm ci
 # Copy frontend source, then build.
 COPY frontend/ ./
 
-# Build-time env: Vite inlines VITE_* vars into the bundle.
 # BUILD_NUMBER overrides vite.config.js's `execSync('git rev-parse')` fallback
 # — git isn't available in this stage, and that's fine.
 ARG BUILD_NUMBER=dev
-ARG VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID=
 ENV BUILD_NUMBER=$BUILD_NUMBER
-ENV VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID=$VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
 
 RUN npm run build

@@ -34,8 +34,6 @@ spec:
               value: "3000"
             - name: AZURE_APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT
               value: https://infra-appconfig.azconfig.io
-            - name: KEY_VAULT_URL
-              value: https://romaine-kv.vault.azure.net/
           resources:
             requests:
               cpu: 50m
